breakdown.description: The nearly incompressible plane-strain problem is switched from a mixed displacement-pressure (u-p) formulation to a displacement-only solve
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly switched to a displacement-only solve. The ground truth corrects this by explicitly stating to use a mixed displacement-pressure formulation. The agent's generated specification incorrectly states, 'The formulation will use a displacement-only vector element', thereby repeating the user's error instead of correcting it.
